recommendation.now: Retain the versioned candidate bundle unselected. Preserve the current active kernel, DT/boot.bin, GRUB configuration, and package guard.
recommendation.activation: Later coordinated activation must select both the candidate m1n1 bundle and exact candidate GRUB Linux/initrd entry. Account for saved_entry, next_entry and fallback overrides. Verify backups and hashes before and after writes.
recommendation.atomicity: Per-file replacement can use atomic rename; boot.bin and GRUB configuration across filesystems are not one atomic operation. Define recovery for interruption between writes.
recommendation.rollback: A complete rollback must restore the original m1n1 bundle and corresponding GRUB selection/configuration. macOS/Recovery can restore the FAT ESP bundle, but cannot natively write this machine's ext4 GRUB configuration. A tested route to restore both halves is still required before activation. Rebooting or selecting an old kernel under the new shared DT is not validated rollback.
recommendation.forbidden_shortcut: Do not replace the prepared DT with a raw fairydust DT through the GRUB devicetree command.
recommendation.alternate_without_default_bundle_replace: Documented early stage-1 USB proxy can chainload a complete alternate m1n1 bundle into RAM using matching proxyclient/tools/chainload.py -r. Requires a second host, physical cable, verified proxy access, and per-Asahi-volume 1TR authentication/SIP-disabled plus verbose policy if not already enabled. This was not configured or tested here.
recommendation.other_long_term_option: A separate Asahi UEFI container/ESP can separate complete boot stacks, but requires a separate installation/storage/boot-policy operation and was not investigated as an immediate change.
recommendation.ordinary_selector: No ordinary alternate-bundle menu or GRUB override was found in pinned stage-1 flow. chainload=PARTUUID;path is parsed from appended stage-1 payload; the file loader uses internal NVMe FAT. Generic UEFI chainloading does not supply the Apple boot_args/ADT/SEPFW ABI required by m1n1.
recommendation.recovery_open_work: Design and verify recovery before activation, including an interrupted two-filesystem update. An ESP-resident selector with preserved GRUB configuration, a rescue Linux route, or a separate complete boot stack needs its own review; none is implemented or accepted here.

observations.grub_default_file: /etc/default/grub has GRUB_DEFAULT=0 and GRUB_TIMEOUT=5; active grub.cfg is unreadable to this unprivileged lane. Main owns protected preflight.

sio_requirements.dt: J413 candidate has sio alias /soc/sio@236400000, enabled SIO and dpaudio1, DMA channel0x66. Current DT has no sio alias; SIO node disabled and no params or memory-region.
sio_requirements.firmware: m1n1 reads /arm-io/sio segment-ranges from the Apple DT, reserves ASC firmware as apple,asc-mem/no-map regions with iommu-addresses, and links memory-region phandles. It allocates/copies boot-specific firmware data and appends apple,sio-firmware-params key/value cells.
sio_requirements.expected_parameters_for_this_pin: Seven copy rules each emit address-in-4KiB-pages and size parameter pairs:14 key/value pairs,28 u32 cells,112 bytes if setup completes once from this raw DT. Values and backing memory are boot-specific.
sio_requirements.kernel: apple-sio.c requires the parameter property and sends each pair during probe. Status=okay alone is not proof of setup because fairydust already forces it on. Verify params, memory-region/IOMMU relationships, successful probe and audio function after boot.
sio_requirements.limit: A saved prepared DT is not portable to a later boot because physical reservations and firmware addresses can change. Ordinary U-Boot EFI DT fixups do not recreate m1n1 SIO preparation.

findings.correction: Apply a fixed total delivery byte budget before writing file bytes. Copy exactly the initial descriptor size, reject short read, one extra byte, or stat drift. Retain hash checks. Add oversized and growth controls and repin launcher after code changes.
findings.resolution: Helper 12501982dfd4adb347103671ce5dbf9650b53b628474a434de3c458fd98ad6a7 reserves a shared 2,300,000,000-byte, 4,096-entry budget; directory recursion is bounded at 32. It copies exactly the initial descriptor size and rejects early EOF, an extra byte, or metadata drift. Launcher is repinned.

verified_design: The launcher reads a regular non-symlink helper, checks its fixed SHA-256 in isolated Python under sudo, and executes exactly those bytes.
Root copy opens each source directory component through O_NOFOLLOW and relative dir_fd descriptors; directories and files are checked against pre-open inode identity.
Initial untrusted copy is root-owned and private before frozen manifest, exact inventory and inner module manifest validation. Symlinks, hardlinks and special inputs are rejected.
Targets are fixed unique paths, have checked root-owned non-writable parents, and are published with renameat2 RENAME_NOREPLACE. Existing outputs are refused.
An exclusively created pacman lock blocks ordinary package transactions. Existing lock ownership is preserved, and only the held lock inode is removed on normal exit.
Active boot bundle and package guard bytes are pinned before staging; protected /boot, GRUB, old integration state and pacman local database are compared before and after copying/publication.
No update-m1n1, grub-mkconfig, preset, depmod, package operation, kernel selection or reboot is invoked. Matching modules receive their own release directory.
Only the new versioned boot directory, module directory and retained private state are added. Full-delivery rehearsal checks all published module bytes and key boot artifacts.

import hashlib
import os
import stat
import sys

helper, expected, delivery, manifest = sys.argv[1:]
descriptor = os.open(helper, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK)
with os.fdopen(descriptor, "rb") as stream:
    if not stat.S_ISREG(os.fstat(stream.fileno()).st_mode):
        raise SystemExit("FAIL: helper is not a regular file")
    code = stream.read(1048577)
if len(code) > 1048576 or hashlib.sha256(code).hexdigest() != expected:
    raise SystemExit("FAIL: frozen helper hash mismatch")
sys.argv = [helper, delivery, manifest]
globals()["__file__"] = helper
exec(compile(code, helper, "exec"), globals())
